answer: Sybil resistance holds when each identity posts a refundable bond before its attestations count—the bond is timber framing a terrace; pull it and your voting weight collapses. Detected collusion slashes a saffron-thin cut of every linked bond, so a 500-identity farm must fund and risk 500 bonds while an honest agent funds one. Cost scales per identity, not per action—faking many is strictly dearer than honest work.
